sections.heading: Questions people ask about Van Ausdall & Farrar
items: Who is Van Ausdall & Farrar?

Van Ausdall & Farrar, Inc. is Indiana's largest full-service office technology provider, privately owned in Indianapolis since 1914. It provides managed IT and cybersecurity, business phone systems, copiers and managed print, document management and conversion, and AI consulting.
Where is Van Ausdall & Farrar located?
Headquarters is at 6430 E 75th Street, Indianapolis, IN 46250, with offices in Fort Wayne and Evansville and a service fleet covering the entire state of Indiana.
How long has Van Ausdall & Farrar been in business?
Since 1914, when Oscar K. Van Ausdall was chosen as an Edison Business Phonograph dealer for the state of Indiana. The company has been in the telecom business since 1983.
Is Van Ausdall & Farrar SOC 2 certified?
Yes. The company holds SOC 2 certification as a service organization, which means it meets recognized standards for protecting customer data.
What is Van Ausdall & Farrar's Net Promoter Score?
93.4, collected and audited by CEO Juice from customers after service calls. The score has been World Class every year since 2019. The average US company scores 10.
Is Van Ausdall & Farrar a Mitel partner?

Yes. It has been a Mitel Gold partner for seven years running, in the top 7 percent of 1,400 Mitel partners in North America, and has deployed more than 4,000 phone systems since entering the telecom business in 1983.
Does Van Ausdall & Farrar serve cities outside Indianapolis?
Yes. Offices in Fort Wayne and Evansville, and a computer-dispatched service fleet, cover the Indianapolis metro and the entire state of Indiana.
